banners.prompt:
Create a NEW photo from scratch. IMAGE 1 is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore its content completely. The photo must fill the WHOLE frame edge to edge (no bars, no borders, no frames).
SAFE ZONE: the top 14% and the bottom 14% of the frame will be cut off afterwards. Keep everything important inside the middle 72% of the frame height.

SUBJECT: an ordinary Bulgarian home kitchen table in the evening, ceiling light mixed with a little window light, photographed from a standing person's eye level, slightly from above, slightly tilted (2-3 degrees), as if someone quickly snapped it with a phone. On the table: an open paperback book lying flat (its pages show only blurred, unreadable lines of text), next to it a small lined school notebook with a few simple English words handwritten in blue ballpoint pen in natural uneven adult handwriting, clearly legible, exactly: "apple", "Thank you", "How are you?" - and a pen lying across it. A half-drunk cup of coffee, a phone lying face down, a few breadcrumbs. On the chair next to the table a pile of folded laundry (towels, a t-shirt). At the edge of the table a plastic grocery bag with vegetables (tomatoes, a cucumber). Ordinary plastic or wooden table, ordinary chair. The only readable text in the photo are the three handwritten English phrases.

PHOTO STYLE (critical): a real, unedited smartphone photo, exactly as it comes out of an average phone camera. Ordinary indoor light, slightly warm white balance, soft and slightly uneven light, mild shadows, slight phone-camera noise, normal phone sharpness. Natural, slightly flat colours. NOT glossy, NOT high contrast, NOT saturated, NOT HDR, NOT cinematic, NOT stock photo, NOT a styled product shot, no vignette, no filters, no bokeh effects. Small real-life imperfections. No captions, logos, brand names, watermarks, prices, arrows or buttons. No people.
